entry.notRun: embeddings: no vectors are inserted, so only the lexical/exact legs return rows (the dense leg has no candidates)
entry.runs: openDatabase/closeDatabase (memory.mjs) on a private bundled PostgreSQL cluster, stopPgForShutdown (pg/supervisor.mjs), recallPlan (recall-hybrid/plan.mjs), buildHybridQuery (recall-hybrid/hybrid-sql.mjs), buildExactTerms (recall-scoring.mjs)

normalised.ids: serial ids 1..N from a fresh cluster, in insertion order
normalised.scoredAtMs: the cluster clock the score trigger read at each insert (NOW()): wall-clock time, recorded

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay: mixdog-services memory/recall/hybrid.rs search_relevant_hybrid (the `memory/recall` request, Recall::recall) on a private cluster (MIXDOG_PG_RUNTIME) holding the recorded rows, inserted in order before each probe as here, each scored by the schema's compute_entry_score at its recorded scoredAtMs (the trigger's expression at the clock it read). Compared per probe: the exact terms, the candidate statement the search sends at its send point (recall/store.rs read_query_pg: text byte for byte and every parameter), and the rows PostgreSQL answered it with, whole and in the returned order
timezone: UTC (process.env.TZ set by lib/mc-record.mjs before any date formatting: local-time text in a recording is UTC)
